flavor_text_entries.flavor_text:
This DEOXYS has transformed into its
aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by
altering its appearance.

form_names.name: ディフェンスフォルム
ディフェンスフォルム

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text:
When it changes form, an aurora appears.
It absorbs attacks by altering its
cellular structure.

A POKéMON that mutated from an
extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser
beam. Its body is configured for superior
agility and speed.

Even Basculin, which devours everything it can
with its huge jaws, is nothing more than food to
organisms stronger than itself.

Some people call it “the thug of the lake.”
Whether the differences in color are meaningful
is not yet known.
